title: Koiwat language - Wikipedia
text: Koiwat is one of the Ndu languages of Sepik River region of northern Papua New Guinea. It is spoken in Kamangaui ( 4.116371°S 143.593484°E), Koiwat ( 4.089795°S 143.555238°E), Paiambit ( 4.11068°S 143.69616°E), and Seraba ( 4.063985°S 143.629118°E) villages of Koiwat ward, Angoram/Middle Sepik Rural LLG, East Sepik Province.
